peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 22.5% below its local comparables; 4 of 85 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (35.9): 2.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 92 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 7). Context, not scored: resales in 25% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $2,468,000 ($1,349 psf, 1,829 sq ft; 5 resales, Nov 2023–Oct 2025); 4 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,741 psf (range $1,481–1,844); 22.5% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $717,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Fernvale LRT about 1,860 m, Ang Mo Kio MRT about 1,990 m; closer than 2 of 462 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Rosyth School about 1,540 m; more than 0 of 462 similar developments (the same as 58). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 890 m), more than 56 of 462 similar developments (the same as 149); nearest hawker centre Cheng San Market And Cooked Food Centre about 1,390 m; nearest park Ang Mo Kio Linear Park (Plot 4) about 220 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Cheng San Market And Cooked Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: No other condo development sold new homes within 2 km. Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 17 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 0 new sales and 325 resales (325 purchases); new sales were 0% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 325 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 32 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 325 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 401 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−19%). Planning-area private resales −15.2%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
